q1_issues.issue: The event class is the verb catch_up, so the passive subject should carry the role its active object would have (Theme/Patient); Experiencer is licensed only as the subject of a stative psych or predicate-adjective predication.

The head 'For' renders a preposition the sentence does not contain — the complement of 'plans' is the to-infinitive 'to expand Wagerup' — and the instruction set requires the preposition actually used, never a near-fit synonym head.

q2_gaps: noun + to-infinitive complement ('plans to expand Wagerup') — the instruction set covers argument PPs on nouns ('a vehicle for V-ing') but gives no head for an infinitival complement
episodic (non-generic) bare plural subject ('plans had been caught up ...') — the plural rules decide by determiner and make a bare plural the generic, which does not fit a specific past episode
sentence-initial discourse connective whose other endpoint lies outside the sentence ('But ...') — the connective rule needs two reified clauses
notes: The garbled 'pro-ject' is read as project, correctly. 'catch_up' kept whole with no genus, 'heated'/'existing' as surface-form participial adjectives, the About/On/Possession chain over the impact nominalization, and the past perfect with no second asserted event to order against are all per the instruction set; fusing 'local_resident' (with both genus atoms) is a borderline call between a role-title fusion and an incidental descriptive modifier that would distribute.
